title.zh: Washington’s big crypto bill is stuck. The SEC is pushing ahead anyway
title.en: Washington’s big crypto bill is stuck. The SEC is pushing ahead anyway

current_state.zh: With Washington's comprehensive crypto market-structure bill stalled, the SEC is moving ahead on its own with a crypto-focused rulemaking proposal, shifting the locus of US digital-asset policy from Congress to the agency.
current_state.en: With Washington's comprehensive crypto market-structure bill stalled, the SEC is moving ahead on its own with a crypto-focused rulemaking proposal, shifting the locus of US digital-asset policy from Congress to the agency.
